claims.claim: Perfectly working and neatly used; selling for upgrade only.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Yamaha-branded full-size electronic keyboard with an LCD and speaker grille, but do not confirm overall functionality or cosmetic condition beyond what is visible.
Photos show keys/buttons, but no test video/audio or proof that every key/button works.
No photo shows the power adapter or included accessories.
No documentation or label details confirming UK purchase are shown.
No audio recording or key-by-key test is shown; LCD is lit but sound quality/crackle is not demonstrated.

risks.risk: Unknown exact Yamaha model; different models have different value and feature sets.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model number/name on the front/back panel (or the label on the underside).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case assumption: generic/unknown Yamaha full-size keyboard with limited confirmed features.

risks.risk: Functionality risk: some keys/buttons may be faulty even if the LCD is lit.
risks.proof: Short video showing power-on and a full-range key test (e.g., play a scale across all keys) plus pressing all visible buttons/sliders.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed (possible intermittent/dead keys).

risks.risk: Speaker/audio health risk: crackling/distortion may occur at certain volumes or with certain keys.
risks.proof: Audio clip/video of playing at low and medium volume through the built-in speaker (include a sustained note to check crackle).
risks.if_unproven: Price as speaker may be weak or noisy (worst-case for built-in audio).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect power adapter risk (wrong voltage/connector can damage or prevent proper use).
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter label (voltage/amp) and connector type, plus a video of it powering the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming adapter may be missing or not confirmed correct.

risks.risk: Cosmetic/physical condition risk: scratches, dents, loose knobs/keys not fully captured in the photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the keybed, top panel, and front corners/knobs (including any gaps/loose parts).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic wear consistent with used electronics.

risks.risk: Connectivity/accessories risk: headphone jack/USB/MIDI/line-in/out and sustain pedal compatibility not confirmed.
risks.proof: Photos of all ports and a video showing sustain pedal input (if available) and headphone output test (if headphone is available).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories/features are not confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the exact Yamaha model number/name (front/back/underside label).
Record a short video: power-on, LCD on, then play a full-range scale to prove all keys; press each visible button/slider once.
Record an audio/video clip showing built-in speaker output at low and medium volume (include a sustained note to check crackle).
Photo of the power adapter (label with voltage/amp) and a video of it powering the keyboard.
Close-up photos of the keybed and top/front panel showing any scratches/dents/loose knobs or missing parts.
If available, show included accessories (sustain pedal, cables, microphone/stand) and test sustain pedal input.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Yamaha full-size electronic keyboard with an LCD and speaker grille, but the key claims that determine price (exact model, full functionality, audio health, and included adapter/accessories) are not proven by the photos. Missing these proofs prevents confident worst-case pricing.
